summary: Prompt #2 auth suite fully tested against public URL + Mongo. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_prompt2.py (auth config, google-503, correct/wrong login, logout revocation, forgot-password neutrality, rate-limit after 10 fails, inactive-user block, change-password wrong/weak/valid + persistence, reset-password weak policy/expired/single-use, recruiter RBAC on admin endpoints). Frontend Playwright: login page loads, Google button hidden (google_enabled=false), password show/hide toggle switches type password<->text, wrong password shows invalid toast, correct admin lands on /admin/dashboard, user menu shows name/email/role, change-password dialog opens via change-password-menu-item, logout returns to /login. Email provider is live: backend logs show POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send returning 202 Accepted with no token/password ever logged.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_service.authenticate registers a failure on invalid credentials but does NOT register one when the account is inactive (line 69-70). If desired to also throttle probes against known-disabled accounts, register a failure before the is_active check. Not a bug per se.

Rate-limit key is `ip:email` — from the public preview the source IP is the ingress, so effectively per-account throttling. Fine for the spec but note that a malicious client sharing the ingress cannot lock other accounts (good), but also that a single attacker can rotate emails to avoid backoff (acceptable given per-account lockout).
reset_password revokes ALL sessions after use (services/auth_service.py:159). change_password keeps the current session (:176). Both consistent with spec.

Frontend Login.js still keeps a placeholder handleGoogle() that only checks window.google?.accounts?.id — the button is now gated by /auth/config so it's dead code today, but leaving it while Google is disabled is fine.
auth_routes.refresh has a redundant `from core.errors import AppError` re-import inside the function (line 71, 75). Minor cleanup.

verified_features: Google button not rendered on /login (data-testid=google-signin-button absent)
Correct admin login -> 200 with access_token + user + permissions; wrong password -> 401 invalid_credentials
login-password-toggle switches input type from password to text
Logout -> 200; reusing the bearer token returns 401 on /api/auth/me (session revoked)
Rate limit: 10 failed attempts on same email/IP -> 429 rate_limited
Inactive user (recruiter is_active=false) -> 403 account_disabled; reactivation restores login

Forgot-password returns identical message body for existing and unknown emails; existing email triggers httpx POST to integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send returning 202; audit log has email_sent=true without token/link
Reset-password: weak password (no digit) -> 400 weak_password; expired token (past expires_at) -> 400 invalid_token; single-use enforced (2nd reuse -> 400 invalid)

Change-password (logged-in recruiter): wrong current -> 400 invalid_credentials; weak new (no digit) -> 400 weak_password; too-short -> 422; valid change succeeds and new password logs in while old does not
Recruiter RBAC: GET /api/users, POST /api/users, GET /api/users/{other_id} all 403
User menu shows name + email + role + Change password + Log out (data-testids present)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. Use `-n 0` to run this suite serially (not `-p no:xdist`). Motor async client can't be shared across pytest event loops — use pymongo (synchronous) for setup/cleanup. When probing invalid users via /api/auth/login and /api/auth/forgot-password, pydantic EmailStr rejects some TLDs (e.g. .local, .tld) with 422 — use example.com. Rate-limit lockout is keyed by `ip:email`, defaults 10 fails / 15 min; clear via db.login_attempts.delete_many. Emergent email provider is live and returns 202 through /api/v1/email/send at integrations.emergentagent.com; do NOT web-search Emergent internals.
